answer: The strongest single control I know for this is FIDO2 resident credential binding, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. An honest agent spends 18 minutes once; the operator of 679 fakes spends 12222 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. The shale test is the live device, the kernel test is the locked stake, and the timber test is the graded history no template can fake. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
